reply: Oh, hello! I did not see you there.
Welcome, friend of the apes. You can ask for my offers or for healing.
My people have troubles. Will you prove you are a friend to the apes?
Our trust is hard to earn. Will you hear my story?
A young ape has fallen ill. I need whisper moss from the eastern side of the upper Dworc lair. Take it yourself and bring it to me.
A young ape has fallen ill. I need whisper moss from the eastern side of the upper Dworc lair. Take it yourself and bring it to me.
I need cough syrup to use the whisper moss. Ask the healer in the human settlement.
Have you brought the cough syrup?
With this syrup I can prepare the cure. Ask me for another mission when you are ready.
I need a bottle of cough syrup.
The little ape should recover soon, but I fear there is more trouble ahead. Will you help again?
The plague was a lizard curse. Will you find the lizard magician’s papers in the village southeast of here?
Report back when you have the scroll.
Have you brought the scroll from the lizard village?
This is the scroll I need. I will study it. Come back when you are ready for another mission.
I need the old parchment. Search the lizard village or ask those who hunt holy serpents.
The holy banana gave me a vision of a stone that could help read the scroll. Look east of the desert city for a buried tomb. Read the signs between two great red stones. Will you go?
Return when you have read the signs.
You have read the signs. May I see what you saw?
Look for the signs in the tomb east of the desert city.
Now I can read the scroll. Ask me for another mission when you are ready.
The charm needs a token of life. Will you bring me a hydra egg? There is a hydra lair near the lake southeast of Banuta.
Come back with an egg.
Have you brought a hydra egg?
This egg will strengthen the charm. Thank you.
Bring me a hydra egg for the charm.
The charm needs witches’ cap. Will you look for it in the hidden dungeon beneath Fibula?
You can enter the dungeon and look for the mushroom.
Have you brought the witches’ cap?
Now I can finish the charm of life.
I need the witches’ cap from Fibula.
A cult is drinking the old lizard brew. Will you take a crowbar and break three casks in the temple under Banuta?
You can enter the cask rooms. Return after breaking three casks.
Thank you for breaking the casks. Ask me for another mission when you are ready.
Destroy three casks beneath Banuta before you report back.
Find a hair from Bong, the giant ape, in the Forbidden Lands. Ask the Blind Prophet in the cave east of the mountains how to enter. Will you go?
The Blind Prophet can grant you passage now.
Did you bring me a hair of the holy ape?
Look for a hair of the holy ape in the Forbidden Lands.
This will give my people a symbol of their faith.
The hair is missing. Return to the Forbidden Lands to look again.
Will you enter the deepest catacombs and destroy the serpent god’s monument with a hammer I can give you?
Take this Snake Destroyer to the monument under Banuta.
You have saved my people. Ask me about my offers or shamanic powers.
Use the hammer to destroy the serpent god’s monument in the deepest catacombs.
I have no more missions for you. You can ask me about shamanic powers.
You already belong to the shamans.
Finish your missions before you ask to become a shaman.
